description: Compare two or more countries on one available dataset topic, such as tax_systems, banking or cost_of_living. Returns the matching source rows side by side; use a specialized compare tool for passport, crypto, freedom or city-safety rankings.

countries.description: Two or more countries to compare. Country names or slugs, e.g. ["Panama", "costa-rica"].

topic.description: The topic to compare on. Dataset topic, e.g. "tax_systems", "digital_nomad_visas" or "cost_of_living".

name: compare_countries
title: Compare countries
